description: This file implements a client for interacting with the 'docs-i18n' RPC service, managing communication with an external process, handling prompts and responses, and parsing JSON messages. It includes starting/stopping the process, reading stdout/stderr, and processing message payloads.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: Manages the external 'docs-i18n' process, communication channels, and synchronization primitives to interact with the RPC service.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the external process and waits for a response, handling context cancellation and process closure.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the external process, ensuring resources are released.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Reads the stderr output of the process and buffers it.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON messages from the process's stdout, dispatching events to the events channel.
